response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"HTML, quoted Matthew 24:6-7","severity":"major","source_quote":"but the end is not yet","suggested_fix":"Replace «ولكن ليس المنتهى بعد» with «ولكن النهاية لم تأتِ بعد» or another Arabic rendering that conveys that the end has not yet come.","translation_quote":"ولكن ليس المنتهى بعد"},{"location":"HTML, quotation from Matthew 16:24-26","severity":"major","source_quote":"For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it.","suggested_fix":"Translate the contrast as losing one's life for Jesus' sake and finding it; for example: «فمن أراد أن يحفظ حياته يفقدها، ومن يفقد حياته من أجلي يجدها».","translation_quote":"فإن من أراد أن يخلّص نفسه يهلكها، ومن يهلك نفسه من أجلي يجدها."},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “First, that which is abroad…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"a God who is alive, sovereign, and holy who will some day require an accounting for all things done in this earthly body","suggested_fix":"Revise the final clause to say that God will one day require an account of everything done in this earthly body; for example: «إله حيّ وسيد وقدوس سيطلب يومًا حسابًا عن كل ما فُعل في هذا الجسد الأرضي».","translation_quote":"إله حيّ وسيد وقدوس، سيطلب يومًا حسابًا عن كل ما فعله الإنسان في هذا الجسد الأرضي"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “What about all the what if ’s…?”","severity":"major","source_quote":"then their outcome will be that They are brought down and [are] fallen…","suggested_fix":"Translate the quoted result as «هم يخرّون ويسقطون…» (or an equivalent that preserves the subject as those who trusted in chariots and horses).","translation_quote":"تكون عاقبتهم أنهم جثوا وسقطوا…"},{"location":"HTML, quotation from Luke 21:26","severity":"major","source_quote":"Men’s hearts [are] failing them for fear","suggested_fix":"Render this as hearts failing because of fear, for example: «تخور قلوب الناس من الخوف».","translation_quote":"تخفق قلوب الناس من الخوف"},{"location":"HTML, quotation from Revelation 9:4-6","severity":"major","source_quote":"those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads … should be tormented five months … and shall desire to die, and death shall flee from them","suggested_fix":"Preserve that the unsealed people are tormented for five months and will long to die but death will flee from them; for example: «أولئك الذين ليس لهم ختم الله على جباههم … يُعذَّبون خمسة أشهر … ويشتهون أن يموتوا، فيهرب الموت منهم».","translation_quote":"أولئك الناس الذين ليس لهم ختم الله على جباههم … يُعذَّبون خمسة أشهر … ويطلبون الموت ولا يجدونه"},{"location":"HTML, quotation from Matthew 25:34-40","severity":"major","source_quote":"Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me","suggested_fix":"Translate “my brethren” as «إخوتي» rather than «إخوتي هؤلاء»? Actually preserve its possessive meaning while making clear that the king says the deed was done to him: «بما أنكم فعلتموه بأحد إخوتي هؤلاء الأصاغر، فبي فعلتموه».","translation_quote":"بما أنكم فعلتموه بأحد إخوتي هؤلاء الأصاغر فبي فعلتم"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “One specific thing that I wish to focus on…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"within the plain communities","suggested_fix":"Use an accurate Arabic rendering for the plain communities (the Plain Anabaptist communities), such as «مجتمعات الأنابابتست السهلية», rather than «مجتمعات السهول», which suggests geographic plains generally.","translation_quote":"في مجتمعات السهول"},{"location":"HTML, paragraph beginning “For many of us, for me in particular…”","severity":"major","source_quote":"What if we were the one who God wanted to say a word for Him out of a life that was living for Him to bring His awareness to one who knows not the One, Living, and True God?","suggested_fix":"Clarify the intended idea: God may want us, through a life lived for Him, to speak on His behalf and make Him known to someone who does not know the one true and living God. For example: «ماذا لو كنا نحن الشخص الذي يريد الله أن يتكلم من خلاله بكلمة عنه، في حياة تعيش له، ليعرّف به شخصًا لا يعرف الإله الواحد الحي الحقيقي؟»","translation_quote":"ماذا لو كنا نحن الشخص الذي أراد الله أن يقول كلمةً نيابةً عنه، من حياة تعيش له، ليعرّف به شخصًا لا يعرف الإله الواحد الحي الحقيقي؟"}],"passed":false,"score":73}
